notes.reason: Grafana saved copies of repeated panels and rows; SlashObserve repeats them from their variable, so only the original is imported.

notes.subject: variable adhoc
notes.reason: Grafana's Altinity plugin applies these filters to the outermost query only; SlashObserve applies them on every table a query reads, subqueries included.

panels.title: Repeated ${repeated_service}
panels.reason: None of this panel's queries can be imported. Altinity macro $columns builds the whole query and is not supported; rewrite it as SQL.

queries.query:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(event_time) AS t,
    service_name,
    _table,
    count() c
FROM merge('default','^test_grafana$')
WHERE service_name IN (${repeated_service}) AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY t, service_name, _table
ORDER BY t

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
      $__timeInterval(event_time) as t,
      count() as c
  FROM default.test_grafana
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  GROUP BY t
)
ORDER BY t

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
      $__timeInterval(event_time) as t,
      count() as c
  FROM default.test_grafana
  WHERE service_name IN ($repeated_service) AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  GROUP BY t
)
ORDER BY t
